title: How to implement a new widget
description: Reference course for adding a new widget type to AI Lecturer. Walks through the five mandatory wiring points (CSS var, Zod schema + build.ts entry, widgetRegistry entry, per-widget editor, SectionSchema variant) using the Histogram widget as the canonical worked example.
